_about: Master data defects, expressed as patches to the system-of-record files only. The engine never sees a 'dirty' flag: it reads whatever the masters say, and reality (planogram, POS registers) stays unchanged.

defects.name: Stale category location
defects.summary: Household moved from aisle 3 to aisle 5 in the refit; the product master still says aisle 3.
defects.howItReachesShoppers: Aisle directory signage and the store app are generated from the product master, so shoppers are sent to aisle 3.

defects.name: Zombie checkout lane L7
defects.summary: L7's register was removed in the refit; its location-master record still says open.
defects.howItReachesShoppers: The queue-call board reads lane status from the location master, so it keeps calling customers to L7.
